messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Novak <claire@megabyteinc.com>, Tomás Ruiz <tomas.ruiz@megabyteinc.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Runbook: staggered arrival windows & on-call fallback for Megabyte workshop

Hi Claire / Tomás —

Thanks again for confirming the dates for the week-of-Jan-10 workshop. We put together a lightweight runbook draft and a couple of scheduling options that should help reduce travel churn and keep a continuous coverage window across EU/US/APAC participants.

High-level proposal (pick one):
- Option A — Staggered arrival + 2-hour overlap each morning (US-west morning / EU late afternoon): preserves focused hands-on sessions for EU and US without forcing red-eye travel.
- Option B — Consolidated hub days (Mon/Tue onsite-heavy, Wed remote smaller teams): fewer travel days but requires evening overlap sessions for APAC.

Operational asks we need from Megabyte this week:
1) Confirm which option you prefer (A or B) by EOD Wed PST.
2) Dietary / shipping windows for demo hardware arrival (deadline: Dec 15).
3) Any strict arrival blackout dates for execs (Tomás / Claire).

Preliminary internal assignments: Monica — onsite logistics & vendor liaison; Rishi — AV fallback & regional on-call; Laura — SOW + prework deliverables. I attached the runbook_draft.xlsx and agenda_v0.3.pdf for visibility.

If this looks OK I’ll update the runbook and publish a final schedule with room reservations and an on-call roster.

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
[attachment: runbook_draft.xlsx (Excel)]
[attachment: agenda_v0.3.pdf (PDF)]

From: Claire Novak <claire@megabyteinc.com>

Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 16:02:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Runbook: staggered arrival windows & on-call fallback for Megabyte workshop

Hi Karthik —

Thanks for the clear options. A few constraints from our side:
- Exec team (Tomás + 2 others) cannot arrive before Jan 9 for visa reasons. They need on-site presence Monday afternoon only.
- Our EU engineering group prefers late-morning hands-on blocks (13:00–16:00 CET).
- We will ship two hardware units (demo nodes) and need a 48-hour buffer at your logistics desk for customs hold.

Given that, we’re leaning toward Option A but would like to keep the Wednesday morning slot light for catch-ups only.

Attached: megabyte_constraints.pdf with shipping contacts and hotel cut-off dates.

Claire Novak
Head of Product Operations
Megabyte Inc.
[attachment: megabyte_constraints.pdf (PDF)]

Subject: Re: Runbook: staggered arrival windows & on-call fallback for Megabyte workshop

Claire — perfect, thanks for the guidance. I updated the runbook to reflect Option A with the constraints you shared. Key updates below and next actions.

Summary of changes (quick):
- Arrival windows: EU engineers — target Jan 9 arrival (local afternoon check-in); Execs arrive Jan 10 morning (on-site Mon afternoon).
- Daily overlap: 13:00–15:00 CET / 04:00–06:00 PST — we will use that as the primary cross-team sync window for joint demos (keeps APAC light).
- Logistics: two demo nodes to be received by Jan 7; Monica to coordinate customs paperwork with your shipping contact.
- AV fallback: Rishi will provision a secondary encoder and a local laptop hot-swap kit; AV runbook attached.

Action items:
- Claire: confirm hotel rooming & whether execs require a dedicated van (due Wed EOD).
- Monica: confirm vendor arrival window and local contact by Thu.
- Rishi: prepare AV hot-swap checklist and validate bandwidth tests with Megabyte's network team (test window: Dec 20).
- Laura: finalize SOW updates for travel/day-rate adjustments (deliverable: Nov 22).

I’ve attached updated_runbook.xlsx (tab: schedule + oncall) and a short AV checklist excerpt in the runbook. I’ll also publish a shared calendar with tentative calendar holds for the proposed windows shortly.

Thanks — will follow up after we hear from Tomás on hotel preferences.

— Karthik
[attachment: updated_runbook.xlsx (Excel)]
